about: Speaker-verification thresholds, from services/voice-sidecar/calibrate.py on 2026-11-20. tLo: one recording against the 3-clip consent voiceprint at a false-accept rate of 1% per model; tHi: the recordings' centroid against the consent voiceprint, above every impostor centroid (target FAR 0.1%). Both models must pass.
dataset: LibriSpeech dev-clean (CC BY 4.0), 40 speakers x 12 utterances, each clean, Opus 32 kbps, 24 kbps headset band (200-3400 Hz) and room noise at 15 dB SNR
limits: 40 speakers is a small impostor set: tHi has no measured false accepts but its true 0.1% point is not resolved. Not tested: zero-shot clones of a person spoken into the live check (red team R3); real webcam and phone mics. Re-run after the owner's own beta recordings.
